def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_income = 2_500_000
    basic_shares = 300_000
    options = 30_000
    exercise_price = 20
    average_market_price = 30

    # Calculate incremental shares using the treasury stock method
    exercise_proceeds = options * exercise_price
    repurchased_shares = exercise_proceeds / average_market_price
    incremental_shares = options - repurchased_shares
    diluted_shares = basic_shares + incremental_shares

    # Calculate diluted EPS and round to the closest cent
    answer = round(net_income / diluted_shares, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
